Package com.egradx.notification.auth

package com.egradx.notification.auth
  • Related Packages

    Description
    com.egradx.notification
     
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    EgradxAuthNotificationActorResolver
    The caller of a notification admin endpoint, from their egradx-auth session: who they are, the organization the session is in, and the authorities egradx-auth resolved for them on this very request — so a role edit takes effect immediately, as on egradx-auth's own endpoints.
    EgradxAuthNotificationViewerResolver
    The inbox viewer, from egradx-auth: who is signed in, the organization their session is for, when they joined it, and when their account was created.
    EgradxAuthRecipientDirectory
    Audiences for bulk sends, from egradx-auth: an organization's active members, or every active user.
    EgradxAuthRecipientPreferences
    Opt-outs, from the preferences on a person's egradx-auth profile — the ones they set on their settings screen (PUT /egradx/auth/my/profile/preferences).
    EgradxAuthRecipientResolver
    Where to reach a user, from their egradx-auth profile: their primary verified address on the channel — one scoped to the organization first, else one that applies everywhere, else, for email only, their login email — and their language.
    EgradxNotificationAccountMessageSender
    Sends egradx-auth's account messages — reset links, invitations, email-change codes and the notices that follow them — by email, to the address itself.
    EgradxNotificationAuthAutoConfiguration
    Wires egradx-notification and egradx-auth to each other: the inbox knows who is signed in, and since when they have been a member; a message to a user goes to their verified address on the channel, in their language; egradx-auth can send the codes that verify those addresses; a bulk send reaches every active member of an organization, or every active user; the admin endpoints know the caller and their authorities, and those authorities live in egradx-auth's catalog — broadcast reserved to the platform organization. Ordered before egradx-notification's own configuration, so that these are registered before its fallbacks check whether one exists.
    EgradxNotificationAuthorityContributor
    egradx-notification's authorities, in egradx-auth's catalog: seeded at startup, listed in the permission picker under "notification", read and manage given to every organization's Admin role, and broadcast reserved to the platform organization by the same rule that reserves egradx.organization.*.
    EgradxNotificationContactVerificationSender
    Sends egradx-auth's contact verification codes, through the channel being verified: an SMS code to a phone number, an email to an email address, a Slack message to a Slack id.
